qualification.details: Project Scientist: B.Tech./B.E. in Computer Science, Electronics & Communication, Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related discipline. Relevant professional/research experience is mandatory. Candidates must have hands-on experience in Radar LiDAR integration and SLAM. Desirable: Experience with Radar LiDAR IMU fusion, Knowledge of factor graphs, pose-graph optimization or nonlinear optimization. Experience with sensors such as Ouster LIDAR, automotive radar, IMU and GNSS/RTK. Experience developing and testing algorithms on real-world autonomous vehicle data. Publications, patents, technical reports, or demonstrated R&D contributions in robotics/autonomous systems will be an advantage.

salary_details.details: Consolidated fellowship/pay-slab ranging from Rs. 47,790 to Rs. 62,350 p.m. plus HRA @30%. Specific pay slabs: Rs.47,790-49,220-50,700-52,220-53,790-55,400-57,060-58,770-60,530-62,350/- p.m.plus HRA @30%

selection_process: Shortlisting based on qualifications and experience Online interview
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Delhi Project Scientist Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 27-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.
